name: Nevada
summary: OSM routing across Nevada with NDOT speed, shoulder, class and 2025 traffic counts, RTC Southern Nevada bike facilities, and FHWA HPMS 2018.
facilitySourceName: RTC of Southern Nevada bicycle facilities
stressLayerName: NDOT roadway inventory (state highways; Nevada publishes no bicycle stress rating)
restrictionLayerName: Bicycle prohibitions (OSM; no statewide NDOT layer found)

agencySources.title: NDOT Asset Linear Referencing System — Outside Shoulder
agencySources.note: supplies measured outside-shoulder width and type on state routes; gravel and earth shoulders are recorded and deliberately not treated as riding space.

agencySources.title: NDOT Asset Linear Referencing System — Speed Limit
agencySources.note: supplies posted speed on state routes; 1,485 of 1,605 current spans carry a 2019 HPMS vintage, and agency speed fills only an estimated value.

agencySources.title: NDOT Asset Linear Referencing System — AADT
agencySources.note: supplies measured traffic counts with count stations and dates; every current span is a 2025 count.

agencySources.title: NDOT Asset Linear Referencing System — Functional Class and Ownership
agencySources.note: supplies FHWA functional class and roadway owner statewide, including local streets.

agencySources.title: RTC of Southern Nevada bicycle facilities
agencySources.note: supplies the existing bike-lane, enhanced-lane and shared-use-path registry for Clark County. Nevada's DOT publishes no bicycle inventory.

agencySources.title: FHWA Highway Performance Monitoring System (Nevada 2018)
agencySources.note: supplies traffic volume for state, county and city roads, with the 2018 release year carried as provenance.
